clear-cache-description: Any saves or states stored on the server will not be affected.
clear-cache-title: Are you sure you want to clear the EmulatorJS cache?
clear-cache-warning: This will remove all saves and states stored in the browser.
delete-memory-card-body: This permanently deletes "{name}" and every saved version of it. This cannot be undone.
jsdos-browser-save-warning: js-dos saves are stored only in this browser and are not synced with RomM.
memory-card-create-failed: Could not create the memory card
memory-card-delete-failed: Could not delete the memory card
memory-card-download-failed: Could not download the memory card
memory-card-hint: The newest card loads by default. Progress syncs back when you exit.
memory-card-import-body: This container already has a memory card holding {count} save file(s). Import it into your library, or start with a fresh card?
memory-card-import-discard-body: The memory card on this container will be erased. Anything saved on it cannot be recovered.
memory-card-no-data: This card has no saved data yet
memory-card-rename-failed: Could not rename the memory card
memory-card-share-failed: Could not change sharing for the memory card
memory-card-unreadable-body: RomM could not read the memory card on this container, so it cannot tell whether it holds saves. Try again later, or start fresh and erase whatever is on it.
memory-card-unreadable-title: Memory card could not be read
memory-card-unreadable-warning: The existing card will be erased and cannot be recovered.
memory-card-upload-failed: Could not upload the memory card
memory-cards-empty: You don't have any memory cards for this emulator yet.
save-data-none-hint: {platform} keeps progress in the game's own save
save-data-none-note: Play, then save in-game. It syncs back when the session ends.
save-data-note: Restored to the console before launch. Load it from the game's own menu.
start-fresh-hint: Pick one below to resume, or hit Play to start fresh.
stream-error-not-configured: No streaming container is configured for {platform}.
stream-error-rom-not-found: This ROM could not be found. It may have been removed.
stream-occupied-fallback: Someone else is currently playing. Try again later.
stream-save-unconfirmed: The emulator did not confirm the save. Recent progress may be lost.
